The '''Hifold Sensory Package''', manufactured by [[Neuro-Saav Corporation]], was a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] implant package that enhanced the [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and [[Ear/Legends|ears]].<ref name="CRFG">[[Cracken's Rebel Field Guide (sourcebook)|''Cracken's Rebel Field Guide'']]</ref>

Using a combination of [[true-fleck brain implant]]s and artificial [[hypergleamum gland]]s to increase the [[Brain/Legends|brain's]] capacity to handle extra sensory input and keep it organized, the Hifold sensory package enhanced all aspects of perception by way of superior visual and aural acuity.<ref name="CRFG" />

In addition, the implant also allowed the user to interpret body language much better; with the implant the user became acutely aware of changes in breathing patterns and subtle changes in eye patterns, with a user being able to interpret this data to tremendous advantage.<ref name="CRFG" />
